section_summary.extract_value: This limitations section identifies methodological constraints of the study, including its cross-sectional (correlational) design, reliance on retrospective recall and self-reported height/weight (affecting BMI estimation), and potential construct omissions. It also notes the sample was homogeneous—mainly White, young adult, middle-class, first-year college women—limiting generalizability, and recommends longitudinal designs and more diverse samples for future research.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'Although correlational data can provide useful groundwork... causal interpretations cannot be made... data were collected in one time period.' 'We also assessed participants' self-reported height and weight... adds social desirability and memory recall error to the estimation of participants' BMI.' 'Another limitation was the homogeneity of our sample. Participants were mainly White, young adult, middle-class, first-year college women, and our findings may not generalize well to other individuals.'
